cancel.FLEXIBLE: Full refund if you cancel at least 24 hours before the start.
cancel.MODERATE: Full refund if you cancel at least 72 hours before; 50% refund at least 24 hours before; no refund after that.
cancel.STRICT: 50% refund if you cancel at least 7 days before the start; no refund after that.
